I don't have access to real-time exchange flow data for AXS (Axie Infinity). Exchange inflow/outflow data requires specialized on-chain analytics platforms (like CryptoQuant, Glassnode, or Nansen) that track wallet movements to/from exchange hot wallets.

Providing a fabricated analysis would be misleading, especially given this project deals with real money trading. If you need this data, consider integrating an on-chain analytics API into the AILA pipeline.
